The memo captures all the key financial terms available in the source document. The Extension Agreement is specifically limited in scope - it only addresses the maturity date extension from June 10, 2027 to June 10, 2028, and references that extension fees were separately agreed upon. The memo appropriately notes that additional financial details (loan amounts, interest rates, financial covenants, etc.) are contained in the original Credit Agreement dated June 10, 2022, which was not provided. All material parties, dates, and transaction terms from the Extension Agreement are properly reflected in the memo.
